stem: Which quotation from the article shows how American Indians were affected by the fall line?

options.label: A
options.text: This fall line has always been a desirable place to live. (paragraph 8)

options.label: B
options.text: The fall line formed a natural border between different groups of people. (paragraph 8)

options.label: C
options.text: From New Jersey to Georgia, on river after river, settlers who bumped up against the fall line stayed there. (paragraph 9)

options.label: D
options.text: They established towns that later grew into cities. (paragraph 9)
